Meet the rangers

We have 31 rangers in summer and about a dozen through the winter. These four run most of the public programs, so chances are you'll meet at least one of them.

  • Ines Okafor

    Chief Ranger

    Nineteen seasons at Echo Basin. Runs the 7 am canoe tour on Saturdays and will absolutely race you back to the dock.

  • Tomás Reyes

    Backcountry Ranger

    Patrols Echo Pass on skis from November to May and keeps the Pass Hut stocked. Makes the best camp coffee in the park, according to him.

  • June Halvorsen

    Interpretive Ranger

    Gives the Echo Point talk at 10 and 2. Can name every bird in the basin by ear and will quiz you on them.

  • Sam Whitlow

    Trail Crew Lead

    Rebuilt the Cathedral Stand boardwalk over three summers. Ask him about cedar if you have an hour to kill.

Echo Basin National Park Echo Basin National Park is managed by the Echo Basin Park Authority.
